records.verificationNote: Preferred: duloxetine DR capsules 30 mg (PDF p.57, Tier 1, no flag); venlafaxine rows PDF p.60. Printed: duloxetine DR caps 20/30/60 mg, venlafaxine IR tabs 25-100 mg, venlafaxine ER caps 37.5-150 mg. Not printed: desvenlafaxine (Pristiq), levomilnacipran (Fetzima), Drizalma; treated as unconfirmed. Document says: "Kaiser Foundation Health Plan does not have a requirement for PA" (PDF p.6) and "does not have a requirement for Step Therapy" (PDF p.7). Drugs not listed are nonformulary; when a Kaiser or referral doctor determines one is medically appropriate and necessary it is covered by formulary exception (PDF p.7; decision within 72 hours, 24 urgent, PDF p.8). Completeness is ambiguous: p.6 defines the formulary as "the complete list of prescription drugs preferred for use and eligible for coverage" but p.2 says "not an all-inclusive list", so absence is not treated as exclusion. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: pick, tier and flags re-read in the document; 3 named absent drug(s) added as nonformulary (exception route)]
